mapper.select: SELECT m.email, m.nickname, m.phone, m.created_at AS member_created_at, m.address, s.plan_id, s.start_date, s.end_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.title ORDER BY b.created_at DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS board_titles, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.created_at ORDER BY b.created_at DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS board_created_dates, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.title ORDER BY i.created_at DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS inquiry_titles, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.created_at ORDER BY i.created_at DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS inquiry_created_dates FROM member m LEFT JOIN subscription s ON m.member_id = s.member_id AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN board b ON m.member_id = b.member_id LEFT JOIN inquiry i ON m.member_id = i.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY m.member_id, s.plan_id, s.start_date, s.end_date;
